graph_contract: Every node is mandatory through the shared prerequisite backbone. A seeded template choice sets node count, depth, and maximum width; its non-goal layer widths are then shuffled with a separate seed stream, and the final layer remains the single goal. OR alternatives vary additional scheduling dependencies.
purpose: Nine exploration and nine task-graph profiles with compact fixed square maps, v2-style variable-width paths, and 0–3% added random walls, at fixed alpha=2; no training split assigned.
spatial_contract: For N task nodes, the fixed square side is max(min_map_side, ceil(sqrt(N / dag_density_over_grid))). Carve paths through N+1 distinct spatial anchors, then convert exactly floor(random_wall_fraction * pre-wall open cells) cells to walls while preserving start and connectivity. Resample within the fixed canvas up to max_layout_attempts until final open cells >= min_open_cells_per_node * N; never resize the canvas. Place tasks and construct the witness after wall placement. All presets use task_coverage=1 and alpha_budget=2 on final open cells.
